newsitem.title: UK: UK intervention board details EU sugar sales.
newsitem.headline: UK intervention board details EU sugar sales.

text.p: A total 64,275 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 42.874 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at Wednesday's European Union (EU) tender, the UK Intervention Board said.
Out of this, traders in Denmark received 20,000 tonnes, in France 36,000 tonnes, in Germany 3,275 and in the UK 5,000 tonnes.
This week's award brings the cumulative tonnage awarded for export from the 1996/97 crop to 2.098 million tonnes.
It compares with the 54,250 tonnes awarded on May 29, 1996, when the cumulative tonnage totalled 2.213 million tonnes.
